meta.name: understand-diff
meta.description: Use when you need to analyze git diffs or pull requests to understand what changed, affected components, and risks

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析代码变更，理解影响与风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要审查代码变更或理解他人提交的影响
copy.tagline_en: Analyze code changes to understand impact and risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to review code changes or understand the impact of others' commits

howto.what: Claude 会分析 git diff 或 pull request，对照知识图谱找出变更组件、受影响组件、受影响层，评估风险，并生成用于可视化的 diff overlay 文件。
howto.when: 当你要求分析 git diff 或 pull request，或询问变更影响时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析当前分支的 git 改动。
say.note: Claude 会检查变更并输出分析报告。

say.text: 这个 PR 的变更会影响哪些模块？
say.note: Claude 会找出受影响的组件。

say.text: 评估一下这次改动的风险。
say.note: Claude 基于复杂度和影响范围给出风险评估。

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes git diffs or pull requests against its knowledge graph to identify changed components, affected components, layers, and risks, then generates a diff overlay file for visualization.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to analyze a git diff or pull request, or ask about the impact of changes.

say_en.text: Analyze the current branch's git diff.
say_en.note: Claude runs the analysis and produces a report.

say_en.text: What modules are affected by this PR?
Assess the risk of this change.
say_en.note: Claude evaluates risk based on complexity and blast radius.
